_comment: Read by ops/release-pipeline.py. `enabled` is the kill switch committed to the repo; ~/.config/carr/release-pipeline.off is the local override that stops this machine without a commit. Either one stops every lane before any command runs.

worker._post_release_smoke: After the live readback, ops/release-smoke.py proves the live system works (read-only journeys, baseline before the release, one retry); a regression marks the release FAILED, rolls this lane back and files a loop. false turns the stage off for this lane.
worker._review_required_after: PRs merged before this instant predate the independent-review merge pipeline; inside a batch they are listed as pre_pipeline_prs rather than blocking a batch. The HEAD PR of every batch always needs its own approving comment: that is the verifier the database binds.
worker._review_evidence: Public repositories: only a comment from an OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR (or a login in review_logins) carries a verdict; the LATEST verdict decides and must be an APPROVE carrying `Reviewed-SHA: <exact PR head SHA>`. Every session posts as the OWNER account, so the verifier identity comes from the merge event (or default_verifier), never from comment text or authorship.
worker._canary_ignored_globs: Mirror of .github/workflows/main-canary.yml paths-ignore: only a commit whose every changed path matches these may be walked past without its own canary verdict.
